2-in-1 Dual Texture Spray

Questions
What's the difference between Booster Pro and Booster Pro X2?
  • Booster Pro X2 features upgraded dual-head technology with 2X power output and 2X electrodes, along with new Dual Mode, Sheet Mask Boost Mode, and AI-powered personalized care through the AGE-R App.
What are the new Dual Mode, Mask Mode, and AI Mode features?
  • Dual Mode lets you combine two modes at the same time, allowing you to target multiple skin concerns in a single routine while saving time. Dual Mode combinations can be customized in the AGE-R App.
    Sheet Mask Boost Mode is designed to be used over a sheet mask to help maximize the absorption of the remaining essence, supporting deeper hydration and a more radiant-looking glow.
    AI Mode analyzes your skin condition and skincare habits to recommend a personalized care routine. This feature is available exclusively through the AGE-R App.
Can I use Mask Mode with a gel mask?
  • We recommend using Mask Mode with essence-rich sheet masks rather than gel masks. Sheet masks that contain plenty of essence help the device glide comfortably while supporting better skincare absorption. For the best experience, pair Mask Mode with medicube sheet masks.
Do I need the AGE-R App?
  • No. You can use the device without the app using its standard modes. However, we recommend installing the AGE-R App to access advanced features such as AI Mode, Dual Mode customization, remote control, and personalized reports.
    Some features, including AI Mode and Dual Mode customization, are available only through the app.
Which app do I need?
  • Download the AGE-R App, create a free account, and connect your Booster Pro X2 via Bluetooth.
Does the device automatically reconnect?
  • Yes. Once paired, Booster Pro X2 automatically reconnects to your smartphone via Bluetooth when the device is turned on.
Can I use Booster Pro X2 every day?
  • Most modes are suitable for daily use. Air Shot Mode is recommended 2–3 times per week, while the remaining modes can generally be used 1–3 times daily depending on your routine.
Which skincare products work best with Booster Pro X2?
  • The device works well with hydrating and nourishing skincare, such as serums, ampoules, creams, and sheet masks. For the best experience, we recommend pairing the device with medicube's PDRN, Collagen, and other moisturizing skincare lines, as well as medicube sheet masks.
    If you're using products with exfoliating acids (AHA/BHA/PHA), retinol, or high concentrations of vitamin C, we recommend introducing them gradually. If you're new to these ingredients or have sensitive skin, start with lower frequency or avoid using them with the device until your skin has adjusted. Always follow the product's usage instructions.
Are there any areas I should avoid when using the device?
  • Yes. Avoid using the device directly over the Adam's apple (front of the neck) and do not use it too close to the eyes. For a comfortable and safe experience, always follow the recommended treatment areas and instructions in the user guide.
Is Booster Pro X2 suitable for sensitive skin?
  • The device offers six adjustable intensity levels, allowing you to start at a lower level and gradually increase as your skin becomes accustomed to the treatment.
How long should each mode take?
  • Most treatments take about 5–10 minutes. AI Mode recommends personalized treatment times based on your skincare routine and skin condition.

Frequently Asked
Questions
What's the difference between Booster Pro and Booster Pro X2?
  • Booster Pro X2 features upgraded dual-head technology with 2X power output and 2X electrodes, along with new Dual Mode, Sheet Mask Boost Mode, and AI-powered personalized care through the AGE-R App.
What are the new Dual Mode, Mask Mode, and AI Mode features?
  • Dual Mode lets you combine two modes at the same time, allowing you to target multiple skin concerns in a single routine while saving time. Dual Mode combinations can be customized in the AGE-R App.
    Sheet Mask Boost Mode is designed to be used over a sheet mask to help maximize the absorption of the remaining essence, supporting deeper hydration and a more radiant-looking glow.
    AI Mode analyzes your skin condition and skincare habits to recommend a personalized care routine. This feature is available exclusively through the AGE-R App.
Can I use Mask Mode with a gel mask?
  • We recommend using Mask Mode with essence-rich sheet masks rather than gel masks. Sheet masks that contain plenty of essence help the device glide comfortably while supporting better skincare absorption. For the best experience, pair Mask Mode with medicube sheet masks.
Do I need the AGE-R App?
  • No. You can use the device without the app using its standard modes. However, we recommend installing the AGE-R App to access advanced features such as AI Mode, Dual Mode customization, remote control, and personalized reports.
    Some features, including AI Mode and Dual Mode customization, are available only through the app.
Which app do I need?
  • Download the AGE-R App, create a free account, and connect your Booster Pro X2 via Bluetooth.
Does the device automatically reconnect?
  • Yes. Once paired, Booster Pro X2 automatically reconnects to your smartphone via Bluetooth when the device is turned on.
Can I use Booster Pro X2 every day?
  • Most modes are suitable for daily use. Air Shot Mode is recommended 2–3 times per week, while the remaining modes can generally be used 1–3 times daily depending on your routine.
Which skincare products work best with Booster Pro X2?
  • The device works well with hydrating and nourishing skincare, such as serums, ampoules, creams, and sheet masks. For the best experience, we recommend pairing the device with medicube's PDRN, Collagen, and other moisturizing skincare lines, as well as medicube sheet masks.
    If you're using products with exfoliating acids (AHA/BHA/PHA), retinol, or high concentrations of vitamin C, we recommend introducing them gradually. If you're new to these ingredients or have sensitive skin, start with lower frequency or avoid using them with the device until your skin has adjusted. Always follow the product's usage instructions.
Are there any areas I should avoid when using the device?
  • Yes. Avoid using the device directly over the Adam's apple (front of the neck) and do not use it too close to the eyes. For a comfortable and safe experience, always follow the recommended treatment areas and instructions in the user guide.
Is Booster Pro X2 suitable for sensitive skin?
  • The device offers six adjustable intensity levels, allowing you to start at a lower level and gradually increase as your skin becomes accustomed to the treatment.
How long should each mode take?
  • Most treatments take about 5–10 minutes. AI Mode recommends personalized treatment times based on your skincare routine and skin condition.

  • Booster Pro Mini Plus is an upgraded version of the original Booster Pro Mini. It features three treatment modes (Red, Blue, and Purple) and five adjustable intensity levels, allowing for a more personalized skincare experience.
    Unlike the previous model, Mini Plus is designed to be compatible with interchangeable accessories such as the Cleansing Head and Face Roller Head for added versatility. It also connects to the AGE-R app, where users can monitor battery status.
    In addition, Booster Pro Mini Plus delivers up to 6.2 times enhanced performance compared to the previous Booster Pro Mini, helping support a more effective daily skincare routine.
Do I need a Booster Pro Mini Plus to use the Cleansing Head and Face Roller Head?
  • Yes. The Cleansing Head and Face Roller Head are designed to work exclusively with the Booster Pro Mini Plus and cannot be used on their own or with the previous Booster Pro Mini.
    To use either attachment, simply open the bottom cover, insert your Booster Pro Mini Plus device, and close the cover securely. Once connected, the Booster Pro Mini Plus powers and controls the attachment during use.
    One Booster Pro Mini Plus device can be used with both the Cleansing Head and Face Roller Head, so you can easily switch between attachments depending on your skincare needs.
What is the head made of, and is it safe?
  • he head is made of surgical-grade stainless steel, a material commonly used in medical instruments. It is durable and suitable for skin contact. Minor surface marks may occur during manufacturing or cleaning, but they do not affect the safety or performance of the device.
How do I attach the Cleansing Head and Face Roller Head?
  • Insert the Mini Booster Pro Plus into the Cleansing Head, then twist until the “O” and “I” markers are aligned and locked. Once secured, press and hold the power button to begin use.
What types of cleansers can I use with the Cleansing Head?
  • The Cleansing Head can be used with both cleansing foams and cleansing oils. Avoid using scrubs, peeling products, or cleansers containing large exfoliating particles, as they may damage the bristles.
Is the Cleasning device water-resistant?
  • Yes. The device is water-resistant for daily use and shower use when the bottom cover is fully secured before use.
What skincare products should I use with the Face Roller Head?
  • We recommend using the Face Roller Head with a conductive gel, such as medicube PDRN Booster Gel.
    The roller is designed to work with a conductive formula to help ensure proper operation and smooth gliding on the skin.
    Using a conductive gel also helps the device maintain consistent contact with the skin during use.
Can I use Booster Pro Mini Plus every day?
  • Yes. Booster Pro Mini Plus is designed for daily use. Start with a lower intensity level if you are new to beauty devices and gradually increase as needed.
    For best results, use for about 5 minutes per session as part of your daily skincare routine.
What skincare products do I need to use with the Booster Pro Mini Plus?
  • Booster Pro Mini Plus is designed to help enhance the absorption of skincare ingredients.
    Red Mode: Pair with PDRN or Hypochlorous Acid skincare to support soothing care and help promote more even-looking skin.
    Blue Mode: Pair with Zero Pore or Kojic Acid skincare to support pore-refining and texture-smoothing care
    Purple Mode: Pair with Retinol, Deep Vita C, or Collagen skincare to support firmer-looking, more radiant-looking skin
    Choose the mode that best matches your skincare goals and routine.
Does the product come with a charging cable?
  • No. Booster Pro Mini Plus does not include a charging cable or charger.
    Please use a USB Type-C cable with an input voltage of DC 5V and a maximum of 2A for charging.
Can I use Booster Pro Mini Plus around my eyes?
  • Yes, but use gentle movements and a comfortable intensity level. Avoid direct contact with the eyes and follow the instructions in the user manual.
Can I use Booster Pro Mini Plus Set on acne-prone areas?
  • Yes. Booster Pro Mini Plus can be used on acne-prone areas.
    For best results, pair it with skincare products formulated for troubled-looking skin, such as Hypochlorous Acid lines.
    Avoid use on open wounds or severely irritated skin.

Evidenced in the medical literature , the literature states: "Regarding the causation of Bell's Palsy, a viral agent has long been suspected and such a mechanism has been established with reasonable certainty for the majority of cases (Baringer, 1996)"

    Most facial electrical stimulation devices on the market operate within the range of 35 to 80mA.
    The Booster Pro, however, operates at just 7mA on Level 1 and 14mA on Level 5.

    This represents only 9% to 20% of the intensity found in other facial electrical stimulation devices readily available in the market. At such low output levels, it is scientifically impossible for the device to cause nerve damage or paralysis.
    This has been confirmed through official clinical safety evaluations.
    Furthermore, there are no scientific papers or studies reporting facial nerve damage resulting from electrical stimulation.
    On the contrary, electrical stimulation is recognized and widely used in the medical field as a treatment for facial paralysis.

    (2) Medical References regarding the cause of Bell's Palsy:

    We would like to clarify that the Booster Pro device does not cause Bell's Palsy. Recently, a viral video on TikTok has been spreading false information claiming that the Booster Pro device caused nerve damage.
    This misinformation has been spreading uncontrollably, not only affecting our customers but also misleading new individuals who are unfamiliar with our brand, medicube.
    As the brand responsible for the production, sales, and distribution of the Booster Pro, medicube has determined that we must address and correct this misinformation.
    First, it is important to note that generally in the United States, facial paralysis, (including Bell's Palsy) affects approximately 40,000 new cases annually.
    The support of medical journalism states that Bell's Palsy is most likely casued by a viral agent. Evidenced in the medical literature , the literature states: "Regarding the causation of Bell's Palsy, a viral agent has long been suspected and such a mechanism has been established with reasonable certainty for the majority of cases (Baringer, 1996)"

    This has been confirmed through official clinical safety evaluations.
    Furthermore, there are no scientific papers or studies reporting facial nerve damage resulting from electrical stimulation.
    On the contrary, electrical stimulation is recognized and widely used in the medical field as a treatment for facial paralysis.

    (2) Medical References regarding the cause of Bell's Palsy:
    According to authoritative neurology textbooks such as Aminoff's Neurology and General Medicine and The Textbook of Neurology, the medically established causes of Bell's Palsy include but are not limited to: Lyme Disease, HIV, Tuberculous, HSV, Ramsay Hunt Syndrome, and Herpes Viruses or Varicella-Zoster Viruses. As such, electrical stimulation is not a recognized cause of these conditions, and attributing such damage to it is both unproven and thus misleading.

    In addition to this serious matter, our concerns for the growing number of fake products that are being marketed as medicube products is a key topic we would like to also address.     We understand the concern that may have arisen from encountering such videos on TikTok. However, we would like to officially confirm that medicube devices, including the Booster Pro, are not the cause of these nerve-related symptoms.

products.title: [GIFT] Deep Vita C Daily Quick Masks
[GIFT] AGE-R Line Shot
products.body_html:
HOW TO USE LINE SHOT
▸ Download the Age-R Device User Guide for step-by-step instructions

Before Use

Press button for 2 seconds to turn on device. Press the mode button briefly to select your desired mode (Shot Mode/Booster Mode).
Shot Mode
Use it 2-3 times a week on dry skin after cleansing.
Booster Mode
Use it daily after cleansing along with your skincare products.
* If you want to use both modes, please use Shot Mode first, followed by Booster Mode.

Shot Mode

Lining : Lightly touch the head ball to your skin and draw along your desired areas. After cleansing, gently glide the head ball along the skin
When using Shot Mode, avoid pressing the head ball too firmly against your skin, as it may reduce effectiveness. use it lightly, like brushing over the skin.

Booster Mode

Circling : Press the head ball firmly against your skin and massage in a circular motion around your areas of concern. After applying your skincare, press the head ball firmly against the skin and roll it.
When using the product for the first time, start from level 1 and gradually increase the level. If you use both modes, please use Shot Mode first and then Booster Mode.
MEDICUBE'S TIP
  • 01. When using Line Shot, use it repeatedly from the inside to the outside of the desired eye area.
    Use it repeatedly according to the mode that targets areas like Eye Bags, Crow's feet, Mongolian Folds, and Sagging Upper Eyelids. Adjust the intensity and time as you use it.
  • 02. After concentrating on eye care, use it on other areas of concern such as the forehead, neck, and smile lines.
    After using AGE-R Line Shot, finish off with your regular skincare products.
  • 03. For soft and plump lips
    Shot Mode
    Use on dry lips by grazing along the lip line. Sweep upwards on the outer corners of the lip.
    Booster Mode
    Apply lip balm and absorb in circular motions.
FAQ
  • 01: Can I use both modes every day?You can use Booster Mode daily, but for Shot Mode, it's recommended to use it 1-2 times a week. Please make sure to follow the recommended usage frequency for each mode, and adjust the usage time and frequency to suit your skin's needs.
  • 02: Does Shot Mode need to be used on completely dry skin?Yes, Shot Mode should be used on dry skin. It will not operate properly if your skin is moist. After cleansing, ensure that your skin is completely dry before using Shot Mode.
  • 03: How many minutes can I use it in a day?On days when you use both modes, please use them in the following order: Shot Mode > Booster Mode, for a total of 6 minutes. Shot Mode is recommended for use once a day, while Booster Mode can be used 1-3 times a day. However, adjust the usage time to suit your skin's condition.
  • 04: Is it safe to use near the eye area?Yes, AGE-R Line Shot is safe to use near the eye area. However, because the skin around the eyes is thin, always start with Level 1 and avoid contact with the eyes. Be cautious while using it around the eye area.
  • 05: How should I use it in combination with the Age-R devices? When using AGE-R Line Shot with the Age-R devices, follow these instructions:
    - If using Shot Mode + Booster Mode together:
    Derma Shot > Deep Shot > Air Shot > Line Shot(Shot Mode) > Line Shot (Booster Mode) > Booster-H
    * After using Air Shot, please avoid using Line Shot(Shot Mode)on the areas previously treated.
    - If using Booster Mode alone:
    Derma Shot > Deep Shot > Air Shot > Line Shot(Booster Mode) > Booster-H
